description: Produce docs/architecture/P15_LENDING.md: full architecture for the Morpho/Fluid-style lending optimizer extending SINCLending with agent rehypothecation. Must cover the rehypothecation engine, the real-time ML collateralization model driven by on-chain wallet behavior, the health-drop yield-hedging router, ERC-6551 token-bound loan vaults, and the rule that Morpho Gauntlet USDC is the ONLY live-eligible venue. Done: reviewed doc with fund-flow diagram, ML feature list, and stated utilization_band and morpho_only_live gate semantics.
title: Draft lending optimizer architecture spec

description: Define Solidity interfaces ISinLendingExtension, IRehypothecationEngine, IMorphoGauntletAdapter, IERC6551LoanVault plus the Python ML-agent API schema in onchain/src/p15/interfaces/ and src/sincor2/agents/p15_lending/api.py. Done: interfaces compile under solc 0.8.24 and every spec flow (lend, rehypothecate, hedge, vault-ops) maps to an interface function.
title: Define lending and vault interfaces

description: Model the economics: 10 bps protocol fee on interest to Treasury 0x09E2891432827D8835d2E9b83B25e2a5ba9612Ac, rehypothecation yield split, utilization-band target ranges, and APR 5.5% derivation. Done: interest/fee model with utilization sensitivity table and the venue-eligibility matrix showing Morpho Gauntlet USDC as the sole live venue.
title: Model economics and 10 bps fee structure

description: Create the repo skeleton: onchain/src/p15/, src/sincor2/agents/p15_lending/, config/agents/, tests/pytest/test_p15_*.py stubs, scripts/deploy_p15.py stub. Done: directories exist, import paths resolve, pytest collects stubs with zero errors.
title: Create P15 repo layout

description: Fill the skeleton with compiling boilerplate: empty SinLendingExtension.sol with ReentrancyGuard/SafeERC20, a Python lending-agent skeleton with error handling and TOA hook stubs, config/agents/p15-lending.yaml with dry_run=true and morpho_only_live=true. Done: contracts compile under solc 0.8.24, agent imports cleanly, CI picks up new test files.
title: Write compiling extension and agent boilerplate

description: Build the real-time ML risk model in src/sincor2/agents/p15_lending/risk_model.py: ingests on-chain wallet behavior and transaction histories, outputs dynamic collateralization requirements per borrower, and retrains on a schedule with drift detection. Done: model trains on scripted wallet histories, produces monotonic risk scores on a held-out set, and publishes requirement updates the contracts can consume.
title: Build ML collateralization risk model

description: Build the agent rehypothecation engine extending SINCLending: agents deploy supplied collateral into whitelisted yield venues, track rehypothecated positions per lender, and unwind on withdrawal demand with a liquidity buffer so lenders never wait on locked yield. Done: onchain/src/p15/ compiles under solc 0.8.24; supply/redeem round-trips hold accounting invariants with rehypothecation active in unit tests.
title: Build agent rehypothecation engine

description: Build the Morpho Gauntlet USDC adapter and enforce the morpho_only_live gate in code: any live-mode call targeting a non-allowlisted venue reverts, while dry-run mode permits stub venues. Done: gate tests prove live mode rejects other venues and accepts Morpho Gauntlet USDC, with the allowlist admin path audited.
title: Build Morpho Gauntlet USDC adapter and venue gate

description: Build the health-drop yield-hedging router: when borrower health deteriorates, cron tasks route fractions of collateral into automated yield-hedging strategies to bolster the position without triggering liquidation. Done: a simulated health drop routes collateral into hedging and the position recovers above the warning threshold in the dry-run scenario.
title: Build health-drop yield-hedging router

description: Build the ERC-6551 token-bound loan vault: each loan lives in a token-bound account so agents execute yield strategies inside the borrower's escrow without taking custody. Done: vault contract compiles under solc 0.8.24; agent-executed strategies run inside the TBA in tests while borrower ownership and withdrawal rights remain intact.
title: Build ERC-6551 token-bound loan vault

description: Enforce the utilization_band gate: borrows that would push utilization outside the band are throttled or reverted, with band parameters governable through the audited admin path. Done: boundary tests prove out-of-band borrows revert and band updates emit events.
title: Enforce utilization band gate

description: Route the 10 bps protocol fee on interest to Treasury 0x09E2891432827D8835d2E9b83B25e2a5ba9612Ac via pull-based claim with a FeeRouted event. Done: fee math unit-checked against interest accruals and the treasury address is immutable post-deploy.
title: Route 10 bps interest fees to Treasury

description: Write unit tests under tests/pytest/test_p15_units.py covering rehypothecation accounting, utilization-band reverts, venue-gate enforcement, and fee math. Done: all tests pass and the suite runs in CI.
title: Write unit tests for engine and gates

description: Write integration tests under tests/pytest/test_p15_integration.py: score a borrower with the ML model, open a TBA loan, simulate a health drop, verify the hedge router intervenes without liquidation. Done: end-to-end dry-run passes with health-factor assertions at each stage.
title: Write integration tests for health-drop flow

description: Write invariant/fuzz tests asserting lender assets always cover rehypothecated exposure plus buffer, utilization stays in-band after any call sequence, and live mode never touches a non-allowlisted venue. Done: fuzz run completes with zero invariant violations.
title: Write invariant and fuzz tests

description: Run a Base mainnet-fork simulation: fork at a pinned block, deploy the extension against forked Morpho state, run the ML model on scripted wallets, and simulate a market downturn exercising the hedge router. title: Run Base fork simulation with downturn
